biography.characterFamilySituation: Mother in Neo-Tokyo (corporate salary-woman at Renraku), estranged father
biography.description: Petite and unassuming, Yuki could pass for a college student — which is exactly the point. She dresses in oversized hoodies and vintage band tees, with a custom-modded Renraku Tsurugi deck hidden in a messenger bag that never leaves her side. Her eyes occasionally unfocus as she interacts with AR overlays invisible to everyone else. A small datajack port is barely visible behind her left ear.
biography.background: Yuki was a prodigy at Renraku's corporate academy in Neo-Tokyo, fast-tracked for a career in corporate matrix security. But curiosity killed the career — she found classified files about Project Arcology during a routine security audit and started digging. When corporate security came for her, she ran. A fixer in Seattle gave her a new identity and she's been running the shadows ever since, using the same skills Renraku trained her to have. She specializes in data extraction, host infiltration, and making security systems look the other way. She still has nightmares about the Arcology.

system.description: A young script kiddie and aspiring decker who idolizes Spectre. Useful for grunt work — maintaining botnets, running distraction hacks, and monitoring GOD activity during a run.
An information broker who trades in corporate secrets and juicy data. Operates through multiple anonymous Matrix personas and never meets in person.
An ork middle-manager at Ares Macrotechnology. Sympathetic to runners after his own bad experiences with corporate politics. Provides inside info on corporate security protocols.
A well-connected fixer who operates out of a high-end bar in Downtown Seattle. Helped Yuki get established in the Seattle shadows when she first arrived from Neo-Tokyo.
